# OAP example profiles

Copied unchanged from the `examples/` and `examples/json/` directories of the
[open-agent-profile](https://github.com/alexmerced-oss/open-agent-profile) repository at commit
`7cb1f973f71f2df9904bfd7aee2394c7f9ead30c` (Apache-2.0). `tests/test_oap_digest.py` checks that Loro computes the same profile and
spec digests for these files as the reference `open-agent-profile` library.
